changeSet.author: nexus-8ptg4
changeSet.comment: manifest_qualifying_hits (nexus-8ptg4): a bounded, never-under-counting hit count of the chunks a manifest predicate admits, driven from the manifest, so the short-page exact re-run is skipped when the page already holds every qualifying chunk. One new table function and its nexus_svc grant; no existing function changes. No data effect: a function definition and a grant only.

rollback.sql: DROP FUNCTION IF EXISTS nexus.manifest_qualifying_hits(text[], jsonb, text, jsonb, text, int, text, text);
